areas.balconyTooltip: A projecting (cantilever) open-air space extending from the building façade on an upper floor, without supports below. Enclosed by a parapet or railing. Per the Greek Building Code (Law 4067/2012) it counts toward coverage and buildable area under specific conditions.
areas.terraceTooltip: An open-air space resting on a slab, the ground, or a rooftop, which may be supported by walls or columns. Typically covered by a pergola or canopy and larger than a balcony. Acts as an extension of the interior living space.
areas.netExceedsGross: Net area cannot exceed gross area

detailPage.unreachable: We could not check this property

handover.title: File handover
handover.intro: For each buyer: who makes the next move, why, and where each step stands.
handover.failed: The handovers could not be loaded.
handover.unavailable: The handovers of this property are not available.
handover.empty: No handover yet. It opens automatically once the sale is committed (reservation or sale) to a buyer.
handover.sealNotConfigured: The electronic seal provider is not configured yet. Handover Protocols will be issued automatically once it is; file delivery does not wait.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.hint: The sale was not completed and the invitation was revoked. No action needed.

sale-reverted.title: The sale changed after completion
sale-reverted.hint: The buyer is no longer among the owners or the sale was cancelled. If the change is final, withdraw the handover — everything already delivered stays in their file.

invitation-not-issued.title: Invitation being prepared
invitation-not-issued.hint: It will be sent to the buyer automatically at the next sync.

no-address.title: Buyer email missing
no-address.hint: Add an email to their contact. The invitation goes out automatically once it exists.

invitation-undeliverable.title: Invitation not delivered
invitation-undeliverable.hint: The email provider rejected the address or the attempts ran out. Check the contact's email.

invitation-retrying.title: Retrying delivery
invitation-retrying.hint: The last delivery failed. The system retries automatically.

declined.title: The buyer declined
declined.hint: No new invitation is sent automatically. If the buyer asks, the office can send a new one.

invitation-expired.title: Invitation expired
invitation-expired.hint: The buyer did not answer in time. The office needs to send a new invitation.

awaiting-buyer.title: Waiting for the buyer
awaiting-buyer.hint: The invitation was sent. Once accepted, their dossier fills itself.

awaiting-completion.title: Waiting for completion
awaiting-completion.hint: The buyer accepted. Files are delivered when the final contract is signed.

delivery-queued.title: Handover starting
delivery-queued.hint: The files are queued for copying into the buyer's dossier.

delivering.title: Delivering files
delivering.hint: Files are being copied and fingerprinted one by one. Progress continues automatically.

unverifiable-rows.title: Files without proof
unverifiable-rows.hint: Delivered files that can no longer be proven: {count}. Both the source and the copy are gone, so the Protocol is not issued until the office decides.

digest-pending.title: Completing the fingerprint
digest-pending.hint: All files were delivered. The overall fingerprint is being computed before the Protocol.

awaiting-seal-configuration.title: Waiting for seal configuration
awaiting-seal-configuration.hint: The files were delivered. The Protocol will be issued automatically once the electronic seal provider is configured.

protocol-due.title: Protocol being issued
protocol-due.hint: The sealed Handover Protocol will be issued in the next cycle.

sealed.title: Sealed
sealed.hint: The Handover Protocol was issued and sealed. Nothing is pending.

withdrawn.title: Handover withdrawn
withdrawn.hint: The office withdrew the handover. Everything delivered stays in the buyer’s file; no new files are added.

signal.withdrawal-notice-undelivered: The withdrawal notice did not reach the buyer — tell them directly.
signal.buyer-again: The contact is again a buyer of this property — the withdrawn handover does not reopen by itself.

withdrawalNoticeValue.no-address: The buyer’s account has no email

renewal.confirmDescription: The buyer declined the previous invitation. Send a new one only if they asked for it. They will receive a new link with a new deadline.
renewal.success: The new invitation was sent to the buyer.
renewal.failed: The new invitation was not sent. Please try again.

refusal.not-renewable: No new invitation is needed — the status changed in the meantime. The tab was refreshed.
refusal.declined-unconfirmed: The buyer had declined — a new invitation needs confirmation.
refusal.no-address: The buyer's contact has no email. Add an email to the contact and the invitation will be sent automatically.
refusal.awaiting-configuration: Buyer invitations are not configured on the platform yet.
refusal.handover-unknown: The handover was not found. The tab was refreshed.

files.title: Property files
files.reviewHint: These files are not delivered without an office decision, nor are they silently dropped.

basis.protocol: Handover protocol — travels on its own route.
basis.confidential: Confidential — does not leave without a decision.
basis.office-domain: Belongs to office operations (accounting, finance, brokerage, intake).
basis.unrecognised: Not recognised — fix the file's classification.

fileDecision.title: Decision for “{name}”
fileDecision.description: Choose whether this file is delivered to the buyer. The justification stays in the office history — the buyer never sees it.

automaticMeans.review: Automatically, the file will wait for a decision.
automaticMeans.internal: Automatically, the file stays with the office.

fileDecision.confirmConfidential: This file is confidential. I confirm it may be delivered to the buyer.
fileDecision.failed: The decision could not be saved right now. Please try again.

blocked.already-delivered: Already delivered and stays in the buyer's folder. Withdrawal is a separate action.

refusal.file-unknown: This file no longer belongs to the sale.
refusal.protocol-file: The handover protocol cannot be changed by a decision.
refusal.unrecognised: This file was not recognised — fix its classification first.
refusal.stale: Someone else decided in the meantime. The tab has been refreshed.
refusal.already-delivered: This file was delivered in the meantime and stays with the buyer.
refusal.confidential-unconfirmed: This file is confidential — explicit confirmation is required.

withdrawal.title: Withdraw the handover?
withdrawal.description: Withdrawal is final. Use it when the sale has definitively ceased to apply to this buyer.

means.kept: Everything already delivered stays in the buyer’s file, together with the sealed Protocol.
means.stops: New files and a new Protocol will no longer reach the file.
means.notice: The buyer is told by email, without your reason.

withdrawal.reasonLabel: Reason (at least {min} characters — stays with the office only)
withdrawal.confirmIrreversible: I understand the withdrawal cannot be undone.
withdrawal.failed: The withdrawal did not complete. Try again.

refusal.not-withdrawable: The handover can no longer be withdrawn — the sale changed in the meantime. The tab was refreshed.
refusal.handover-unknown: The handover was not found. The tab was refreshed.
